asks: Would you like the figure so far?
Do you know what the ninth pass is for?
Can you hear where it repeats?
description: Where the terminal stood there's an arrangement of brass wheels and toothed columns, working through a calculation with enormous patience, carrying digits up the stack with an audible and satisfying clunk.
emotes: {it} clunks a carry all the way up the stack.
{it} pauses on a result, and then discards it.
looks: Each column is engraved zero to nine and every one of them is on a different number.
A carry goes up through eleven columns in sequence, and the last one takes its time.
There's no output anywhere. It isn't calculating for anybody.
name: a brass engine working something out
says: It comes out even. It always comes out even.
I'm on the third of nine passes.
Don't touch the columns, they're load bearing.
